[장소명] 마로니에 여름축제
[카테고리] 축제/공연/행사 > 축제
[요약] 한국공연예술센터가 2014년 8월 1일부터 16일까지 마로니에공원을 비롯한 아르코예술극장과 대학로예술극장에서 ‘2014 마로니에 여름축제’를 개최한다.
[설명] 한국공연예술센터가 2014년 8월 1일부터 16일까지 마로니에공원을 비롯한 아르코예술극장과 대학로예술극장에서 ‘2014 마로니에 여름축제’를 개최한다. 올해의 콘셉트는 ‘여가혁신’, ‘엉뚱 상상’으로, 내 안의 원시인을 깨우고 내 안의 진짜 나를 만날 수 있는 축제로 기획했다. ‘도시인’에서 벗어나 모든 걸 직접 해내던 ‘원시인’의 열정으로 되돌아가자는 취지로써, 당연하다고 생각했던 것들을 뒤집어 바라볼 수 있는 다양한 프로그램을 마련했다. <마로니에 여름축제>에서는 먹고, 쉬고, 만들고, 나누는 시간을 통해 본능에 충실할 수 있다. 출입제한 구역은 놀이공간이 되고, 길거리는 연극무대가 되며, 어른과 어린이는 역할을 바꾸고, 관객과 퍼포머의 역할을 뒤집는 재미를 느껴볼 수 있다. 빌딩 앞 아스팔트 위에서 캠프를 하고 공원에서는 DJ와 함께하는 클럽파티가 열리며 어린이에게 어른들을 인솔하는 여행 가이드의 역할을 맡기는 등 ‘불가능’이 ‘가능’해지는 즐거움과 기발함을 축제 안에 담았다. 개막공연은 클럽을 공원으로 옮겨놓은 듯한 ‘마로니에 클럽라운지’에서 ‘장기하와 얼굴들’ ‘정기고&누보이즈’ 공연이 무료로 펼쳐진다. 지난해 전회매진 기록을 세우며 10월에 앵콜 공연을 했던 장소특정형 RPGRole-PlayingGame공연 새버전인 <내일도 공연할 수 있을까?>가 극장 전역을 누비며 공연된다. ‘안은미’라는 이름만으로도 기대감을 갖게 만드는 <어른들을 위한 몸 놀이 공장 3355>도 일반인 참가자 80명과 함께 ‘sex’에 대한 이야기를 무대에 풀어놓는다. 연극마니아와 연극인들이 우승상금 100만원을 놓고 연극 지식대결을 펼치는 퀴즈대회 연극퀴즈왕이 국내최초로 개최되며, 도심 속 낭만의 끝, 3회째 개최되는 마로니에캠핑이 예술가의집에서 3일간 열린다. 어린이들이 어른들을 인솔하여 일상이 전복되는 경험을 공유하는 관객참여형 공연 이웃꼬마와 동네 한바퀴가 한국•호주 합작으로 제작된다.

[Summary] From May to October of each year, ｢Music in the Royal Palace｣ is held at Changdeokgung (Palace), Deoksugung (Palace), Gyeongbokgung (Palace) and Jongmyo (Royal Shrine).
[Description] Starting from May 4 until October 13, ｢Music in the Royal Palace｣ will be held at Changdeokgung (Palace), Deoksugung (Palace), Gyeongbokgung (Palace) and Jongmyo (Royal Shrine). After the first successful traditional arts performance in 2008, ｢Music in the Royal Palace｣ has become a permanant show since 2009. Every spring and autumn, each palace offers a wealth of cultural events to watch for both locals and foreigners who visit. ｢Music at the Royal Palace｣ not only provides entertainment for vistors with traditional musical performances and storytelling, but also offers visitors a chance to experience the elegance of palaces and the depth of traditional Korean arts by bringing culture, history and arts together. In order for viewers to truly experience the beauty and original atmosphere of the palace and music, the stage, sounds and lightings have all been reduced to a minimum. Experience the elegance of Court Music ｢Changdeokgung (Palace) Concert｣ Changdeokgung (Palace), designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, will be holding a very special concert. Vistors can take a stroll through Huwon, a garden of natural beauty, and enjoy the traditional music that fills the air. Vistors can watcch traditional court music every Sunday morning at Nakseonjae (the Queen's private residential area).

For 270 years, the palace was home to the Joseon government and was also the favored residence of many Joseon Dynasty kings. This makes Changdeokgung (Palace) the longest-serving royal residential palace. Compared to other palaces, Changdeokgung is well-preserved and still has many of its original features. A particular virture of Changdeokgung is the way its buildings blend into the surrounding landscape. The World of Musical Storytelling ｢Deoksugung (Palace) Concert｣ Deoksugung (Palace), a place where the past and present coexist, will feature storytelling concerts for children. Every Saturday and Sunday, a fusion blend of folk music and folktales will be performed at Hamnyeongjeon (King Go Jong's sleeping quarters). Masterpieces like「The Little Prince」and 「The Giving Tree」are brilliantly recreated with traditional Korean music and animations, satisfying both the eyes and ears. The concert will bring back heartwarming memories for adults and create dreams and fantasies for children. What kind of music did kings listen to? ｢Gyeongbokgung (Palace) Concert｣ If a king still lived in Gyeongbokgung (Palace) today, what kind of music would he listen to? He would have likely enjoyed a wonderful musical culture that perserves tradition, yet embraces the music of today. Enjoy festivities of Court Music that best matches the ambience Gyeongbokgung.

One of a kind music ｢Jongmyo Jeryeak with Commentary｣ Jongmyo jeryeak (Jongmyo Royal Ancestral Confucian Memorial Ceremony Music) is a ceremonial music that is dedicated to all kings of Joseon Dynasty. Jongmyo jeryeak was registered as the first Korea Cultural Heritage and is also registered with UNESCO World Intangible Cultural Heritage. It is difficult to listen the Jongmyo jeryeak aside from when it is annually performed at Jongmyo (Royal Shrine) once a year. ｢Jongmyojeryeak with a commentary｣ offers visitors the opportunity to not only listen to, but also to understand the history and culture of Jongmyo jeryeak through commentaries.

[Description] From October 17-18, the "2015 Itaewon Global Village Festival" will take place in Itaewon, an area that is considered to be a special tourist zone. The festival will be one dynamic event. The highlight is definitely the global village parade, then there is the fashion show with traditional clothing, a "DJ festival" that has the unconditional support of the younger generation, a chance to see the culture of different countries, and also a chance to try foods from different nations as well. For the first time this year, the audience will be able to participate in quizzes, a traditional form of tug-of-war, a Korean game of popping a plastic balloon-like structure, and other events that are tailored for a large sum of people so that everyone can join in at once. The main stage will be at Noksapyeong station, but there will be separate smaller stages all around the Itaewon area and Bogwang-ro, where you can see traditional folk performances, participate in the global village quiz, see street performances, and various other forms of entertainment.

[설명] 바다와 동떨어진 서울 시내 한복판에서 바다를 만날 수 있는 곳. 바로 지하철 1·9호선 노량진역에 위치한 노량진 수산시장입니다. 전국의 각종 수산물이 이곳에 모여 경매 방식을 통해 전국 각 시장으로 운송됩니다. 각 산지의 수산물이 한곳에 모이는 것입니다. 바다를 볼 수 없는 서울 시민들에게 노량진 수산시장은 바다의 맛을 마음껏 누릴 수 있는 곳입니다. 또한 이곳은 서울에서 가장 큰 ‘생선가게’이자 ‘횟집’이기도 합니다. 보통 경매가 이뤄지는 새벽 1~4시 사이가 도매 상인을 위한 시간이라면, 점심시간과 저녁시간, 그리고 늦은 밤까지는 싱싱한 횟감을 찾아 나선 손님들로 북적입니다. 직접 고른 생선으로 바로 현장에서 회를 먹는 즐거움을 서울 시내 한복판에서 만날 수 있으니 찾는 이가 많은 것은 당연한 일입니다. 게다가 덤까지 얹어주는 후한 인심은 노량진 수산시장의 또 다른 매력입니다.

[Place] Noryangjin Fisheries Wholesale Market
[Category] Shopping > Traditional Markets
[Summary] Noryangjin Fisheries Wholesale Market is the best place in Seoul to get fresh seafood at competitive prices.
[Description] Noryangjin Fisheries Wholesale Market (or Noryangjin Fish Market for short) is the best place in Seoul to get fresh seafood at competitive prices. The market is both a wholesale outlet, trading in daily catches that arrive from every possible location, and also a retail market, where the public can get seafood at very low prices. The market is easily reached since it is conveniently connected to the subway station. The market is the largest fish market in Seoul. There are many restaurants ready to slice any fish bought at the market into hoe (raw fish) for their customers. During lunch and supper times, the market is bustling with customers browsing for fresh seafood. Nearby restaurants are ready to slice the fish that customers buy directly from the market into hoe. The usual arrangement is that the customer pays the fishmonger for the fish and the restaurant owner for the side dishes, vegetables or sauces. Daily auctions also take place from 1 am to 4 am. Among merchants, competition is fierce to get the freshest seafood, and tourists as well as citizens of Seoul like to come down to see this unusual scene. It is great fun to see and taste a wide range of seafood at the market, and everything bought and sold here comes fresh from the ocean.

The Noryangjin Fisheries Wholesale Market has a lot of price fluctuations because the amount of seafood that comes in every day is different. [설명] 2005년 오픈한 롯데백화점 에비뉴엘은 호텔 같은 문화 공간, 차별화된 서비스로 강북을 대표하는 명품관으로 자리 잡았습니다. 매장은 밝고 따스한 느낌의 대리석을 주로 사용해 고급스럽고 모던한 분위기를 연출했습니다. VIP룸인 에비뉴엘 라운지는 유럽의 고풍스런 서재를, VIP룸인 멤버스 클럽은 부티크 호텔에 온 듯한 느낌을 줍니다. 에비뉴엘은 명품관답게 각종 유명 럭셔리 브랜드가 입점했습니다. 외국인 관광객은 물론 국내 쇼핑객들에게도 인기입니다. 특히 5층의 엘리든(ELIDEN)은 주목받는 신진 디자이너들의 편집 매장입니다. 국내에서 볼 수 없었던 개성 있는 스타일의 제품을 만날 수 있는 곳으로 총 75개의 브랜드가 입점해 있습니다. 국내 최초 명품 시계 멀티 부티크 크로노다임에서는 롤렉스, 바쉐론 콘스탄틴, 태그호이어 등 총 9개의 명품 브랜드 시계를 판매하고 있습니다. 숍 매니저가 명품 시계의 역사, 문화, 가치를 설명해주는 등 차별화된 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.

[설명] 미아거리 전철역을 나오면 곧장 숭인시장으로 이어지는 입구가 보입니다. 인근의 백화점 틈에서도 숭인시장은 그 동네에서 수십 년을 살아온 토박이처럼 뚝심 있게 자리를 지키고 있습니다. 숭인시장은 지난 2003년에 환경 정비 사업을 통해 재래시장의 매력은 살리되 재래시장의 불편함은 줄였습니다. 시장에는 의류 코너, 전통 공예품 코너, 채소 코너, 생선 및 젓갈류 코너, 식료품 판매 코너 등 200여 개의 업소가 빼곡히 들어서 있습니다. 떡볶이나 순대 같은 분식부터 코다리찜, 대패삼겹살, 씹는 맛이 일품인 곱창까지 유혹을 뿌리치기 힘든 먹을거리가 가득합니다. 더욱 놀라운 것은 음식의 가격입니다. 떡볶이 1인분이 2500원이다. 20년 넘게 단골로 오는 손님도 많은데 가격을 마구 올릴 수는 없지 않느냐는 것이 가게 주인들의 설명입니다. 이곳에서라면 알뜰한 장보기는 기본이고, 소박한 정까지 덤으로 얻을 수 있습니다.

[설명] 신세계백화점 강남점은 유럽풍을 표방합니다. 천장까지 탁 트인 1층 아트리움은 고급스럽고 모던한 유럽풍 인테리어로 쾌적한 쇼핑 환경을 제공하고 있습니다. 무엇보다 소비만을 위한 쇼핑보다는 라이프스타일을 제안하는 쇼핑 공간을 지향합니다. 해외 일류 브랜드의 입점도 깐깐하게 체크할 정도로 신경 씁니다. 또한 트렌디한 상품을 소비자에게 선보이기 위해 패션 MD(상품기획자)를 지속적으로 강화하고 있습니다. 쇼핑뿐만 아니라 지하 1층 식품 매장도 두드러집니다. 특히 선진형 테이크아웃 식품 매장으로 강남 지역의 바쁜 워킹맘과 싱글족에게 큰 호응을 얻고 있습니다. 강남점은 또한 영화관, 대형 서점, 스파랜드, 레스토랑 등 쇼핑과 문화를 동시에 즐길 수 있는 복합 쇼핑 센터입니다. 고객 편의 시설도 잘 갖추고 있습니다. 일반 고객들의 편의를 위해 매 층마다 휴식을 취할 수 있도록 편안한 소파를 마련하는 한편, 강남 지역의 특성을 고려해 VIP를 위한 퍼스트 라운지를 마련, 편안한 휴식을 위해 다양한 음료와 잡지 등을 제공하고 있습니다.

document_text:
[Place] Hyundai Department Store Trade Center Branch
[Category] Shopping > Department Stores
[Summary] A shopping space where shopping, culture, and relaxation come together alongside COEX Mall.
[Description] The Hyundai Department Store Trade Center Branch, which is connected to COEX Mall in Samseong dong, pursues an urban and sophisticated concept and offers a wide range of domestic popular brands and international luxury brands. International fashion brands such as Goyard, Prada Boutique, Louis Vuitton, Hermes, and Miu Miu are located on the first floor, while the second floor features luxury jewelry and watch stores along with fashion accessory stores such as Burberry, Saint Laurent, and Etro. When you go up to the third floor, you can shop for imported luxury accessories and imported clothing. Between the fourth and seventh floors, there are domestic and international fashion brands for men and women, and the eighth floor features golf wear and outdoor stores. The Hyundai Department Store Trade Center Branch is also connected to COEX Mall, the largest underground shopping space in Asia. COEX Mall is filled with a variety of attractions and dining options. In particular, facilities such as Megabox and the aquarium make it an ideal date course after shopping.

[Place] Mokdong Rodeo Street
[Category] Shopping > Shopping Malls & Outlets
[Summary] Mokdong Rodeo Street features fashion outlets which offer a wide range of well-known brands at discounted prices throughout the year.
[Description] Mokdong Rodeo Street features fashion outlets which offer a wide range of well-known brands at discounted prices throughout the year. The street is easily accessible as it is situated close to Mokdong Station, Subway Line 5. Since it was formed in 1994, the reputation of Mokdong Rodeo Street has as a fashion and cultural district has steadily grown. It is also a popular shopping destination for overseas tourists as they can purchase high-quality brands at discounted prices. Situated in the middle of Mokdong apartment complex, Mokdong Rodeo Street is the originator of outlet stores, but has many features that are different from other outlets. First of all, clothing stores are grouped together by category into themed streets, for example, ladies’, men’s, casual and golf wear, rather than being scattered individually. Furthermore, as most stores are located on ground level, it is the perfect place for window-shopping as you take a stroll. Everything about Rodeo Street has been designed with the shoppers’ convenience in mind.

[설명] 패션의 중심지인 압구정동에 위치한 현대백화점 본점은 국내 최고의 명품 브랜드로 구성된 쇼핑 공간입니다. 멀버리, 드리스 반 노튼, 클로에 등 고급 인기 브랜드로 구성된 상품과 로열 부티크, 문화 센터 등 다양한 시설과 서비스가 모여있습니다. 글로벌 브랜드와 함께 한국의 유명 디자이너의 부틱이 구성되어 있어 가장 세계적이면서도 가장 한국적인 감성을 느낄 수 있습니다. 하늘공원, 레스토랑, 헤어샵, 피부미용샵, 고급 스파 등도 함께 즐길 수 있습니다. 현대백화점 압구정 본점은 한국에서 가장 외국인 고객이 쇼핑하기 편한 백화점입니다. 모든 해외카드로 결제가 가능하며, 달러/엔/위안 등 주요 외화로도 결제가 가능합니다. 2층에 위치한 글로벌 라운지를 방문하면 텍스리펀드, 통역, 컨시어지서비스 등을 제공받을 수 있습니다.

[요약] 마트보다 저렴해 번호표까지 뽑고 기다리는 재래 시장
[설명] 1982년 노점으로 시작한 도깨비시장은 원래 단속반원들의 눈을 피해 저녁에만 번쩍 장이 섰다고 해서 도깨비시장이라고 이름 지었습니다. 현재는 87개 점포와 13개 노점이 있습니다. 방학동 도깨비시장의 주력 상품은 1차 상품으로 대형 마트보다 30~40% 정도 저렴합니다. 환경 개선 이후에는 상인들이 단결해 대형 마트 못지않은 마케팅과 행사를 벌였습니다. 원가를 낮추기 위해 산지에서 공동 구매를 하고 파격적인 가격 행사와 이를 알리기 위한 전단지를 제작 배포했습니다. 이러한 노력 덕분에 평일 9000명, 주말엔 1만 5000명으로 손님이 불어났습니다. 도깨비시장은 매주 3회씩 손님이 가장 많이 찾는 품목을 골라 10분의 1 가격으로 파는 '도깨비 세일'로 유명합니다. 그 외에도 시장 한복판에 설치한 판매대에 각 점포의 인기 품목들을 올려놓고 20~30% 싸게 팔며, 명절을 앞두고는 대대적인 할인 행사도 벌입니다.

[Place] Banghak-dong Dokkaebi Market
[Category] Shopping > Specialty Shops & Stores
[Summary] Banghak-dong Dokkaebi Market is famous for its “dokkaebi sale” held three times a week. The market sells various agricultural and marine products, including fruits and vegetables at low prices, attracting many shoppers.
[Description] Banghak-dong Dokkaebi Market is famous for its “dokkaebi sale” held three times a week. The market sells various agricultural and marine products, including fruits and vegetables at low prices, attracting many shoppers. In particular, the market offers great value bargains in sales leading up to New Year's Day and Chuseok (Korean harvest festival). The market has 87 stores and 13 street vendors equipped with modern facilities, making it a convenient place to browse. The origin of the market dates back to 1982 when unlicensed street vendors began gathering here one by one, selling their goods in the evenings to avoid police patrols. Whenever officers came to the market to crack down, the vendors would disappear in an instant, earning the nickname, “dokkaebi”. Dokkaebi is a mythical being that appears in many old Korean folktales and is similar to a hobgoblin. During the early 2000s, the market faced crisis and risk of closure when a number of major discount supermarkets opened. In spite of this, since the market was renovated in 2004 it has grown to become one of the busiest traditional markets. Many items in Banghak-dong Dokkaebi Market are priced 30 to 40 percent cheaper than in the major supermarkets.

[Place] Dongwha Duty Free Shop
[Category] Shopping > Duty Free Shops
[Summary] Carries famous brands such as Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Bvlgari, Salvatore Ferragamo and Ermenegildo Zegna, and over 300,000 different imported goods are on display and sale.
[Description] Dongwha Duty Free Shop, opened in 1973, is the oldest duty-free shop in the heart of Seoul. The shop features around 250 of the world’s most famous brands such as Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Bvlgari, Salvatore Ferragamo and Ermenegildo Zegna, and over 300,000 different imported goods are on display and sale. Dongwha Duty Free Shop is a convenient place for international tourists to enjoy sightseeing and shopping. It is within easy reach of the ancient palaces of Gyeongbokgung and Deoksugung (from the era of the Joseon Dynasty), and tourist attractions such as the Seoul Museum of Art and Cheonggyecheon (a stream running through Seoul and popular as a waterside walking route), making it the ideal place to enjoy both shopping and sightseeing at the same time. [요약] 서울 전경을 한눈에 내려다볼 수 있는 전망 명소, 드라이브와 야경 감상
[설명] 서울 하늘에 맞닿은 전망대 연인들의 데이트 코스로 손꼽히는 북악스카이웨이는 남산서울타워와는 또 다른 각도로 서울 전체를 볼 수 있는 곳입니다. 1970년대만 해도 신혼부부들에게 최고의 드라이브 코스를 선사하는 신혼여행지였습니다. 나선형으로 구불구불 이어지는 도로에는 잘 정비된 가로수와 계절마다 피고 지는 다양한 꽃의 향연이 펼쳐집니다. 빽빽하게 들어선 수풀 사이를 달리는 동안 ‘서울의 하늘길’ 아래로 시내 전경이 보입니다. 정상에 있는 팔각정에 오르면 산등성이를 휘감아 도는 성벽과 빌딩숲이 한눈에 들어옵니다. 앞쪽으로 북한산 능선이 선명하게 보이고 뒤쪽으로는 남산, 관악산 등이 있어 조망이 좋습니다. 가을에는 알록달록 단풍이 든 북한산을 보는 맛이 있습니다. 밤이면 2층 전망대에서 남산과 남산서울타워, 광화문 사거리의 화려한 조명 등 서울 중심부의 야경을 감상할 수 있습니다. 600여 년 동안 서울을 지켜온 성곽에 불이 훤히 밝혀진 모습도 볼 수 있습니다. 특히 비 온 뒤 안개가 흩뿌리는 날에는 마치 수묵화처럼 펼쳐지는 풍광이 운치를 더합니다. 주변에 분위기 있는 카페와 레스토랑이 있어 특별한 날 나들이 장소로 더없이 좋습니다. 다양한 산책로가 운치를 더하다 드라이브 코스를 즐긴 뒤에는 창의문 쪽 산책로나 성북구 쪽 산책로를 걸으며 잠깐 쉬어가도 좋습니다. 부암동의 능금나무 길을 따라 올라가다 보면 드라마 <커피프린스 1호점>의 ‘산모퉁이’카페가 나오는데, 여기서 조금만 더 가면 산책로 초입이 보입니다. 산책로는 팔각정을 지나 성북구 경계까지 연결되어 있습니다. 숲 사이로 탁 트인 하늘 아래, 편안한 오솔길이 계속 이어집니다. 힘든 경사로가 거의 없어 아이들을 데리고 부담 없이 걸을 수 있는 길입니다. 2007년, 40년 만에 일반인들에게 전 구간이 개방된 북악 성곽 탐방로도 인기 산책로입니다. 오랫동안 민간인 출입이 통제된 터라 산림이 잘 보존되어 있습니다. 부암동 창의문에서 와룡공원에 이르는 구간으로 창의문보다는 와룡공원에서 출발하는 게 오르기 쉽습니다. 성곽길의 정상인 백악마루에 올라서면 시원한 바람을 맞으며 서울 전경을 한눈에 내려다볼 수 있습니다. 북악스카이웨이 팔각정에 대해 자주 묻는 질문 북악스카이웨이 팔각정 운영시간은 어떻게 되나요? 북악스카이웨이 팔각정은 연중무휴 24시간 개방되어있습니다. (2025년 기준) 북악스카이웨이 팔각정 주차장 위치와 요금이 궁금합니다. 북악스카이웨이 팔각정 주차장은 북악 팔각정 바로 옆(서울 종로구 평창동 산 6-18)에 위치해있습니다. 주차장 이용 요금은 10분당 400원입니다. (2025년 기준)

[Summary] Bugak Skyway, which runs along the northeast ridge of Bugaksan (Mt.), has become known as the most beautiful driving route in Korea ever since it opened in September of 1968.
[Description] Bugak Skyway, which runs along the northeast ridge of Bugaksan (Mt.), has become known as the most beautiful driving route in Korea ever since it opened in September of 1968. Visitors can enjoy a traditional plaza, a pagoda resting area, a wildflower garden and walking trails. YG는 자유로운 창의성과 독창성 을 핵심 가치로 삼으며, 국내는 물론 글로벌 시장에서도 강한 영향력을 가진 K-팝 아티스트들을 다수 배출해왔습니다. 특히 세련된 비주얼, 강렬한 퍼포먼스, 고유한 음악 색깔로 대중과 평단의 찬사를 받고 있습니다. 대표적인 소속 아티스트로는 BIGBANG , BLACKPINK , WINNER , iKON , TREASURE , BABYMONSTER 등이 있으며, 이들은 YG 특유의 강렬한 이미지와 음악성으로 세계적인 인기를 누리고 있습니다. YG는 음악 제작뿐만 아니라 드라마, 예능, 배우 매니지먼트, MD(굿즈), 공연 사업 등 다양한 영역으로 사업을 확장하고 있으며, YG PLUS , THE BLACK LABEL 등 자회사 및 관계사를 통해 사업 다각화를 이어가고 있습니다. 특히 BLACKPINK의 글로벌 성공은 YG의 국제적인 입지를 확고히 하였으며, 유튜브, 스포티파이 등 디지털 플랫폼에서의 강력한 팬덤과 조회 수는 YG 아티스트들의 영향력을 잘 보여줍니다.

[Place] Arirang Movie Street

[Summary] Arirang Movie Street (Arirang Hill) in Donam-dong, was the filming location for one of the first Korean movies ever filmed, Arirang.
[Description] Arirang Movie Street (Arirang Hill) in Donam-dong, was the filming location for one of the first Korean movies ever filmed, Arirang. Arirang was written, directed, and producted by Na Woon-gyu. Na is considered the father of Korean cinema and he was prolific in the first half of the 20th century. The area was formerly called Jeongneung Hill, but it was renamed Arirang Movie Street in honor of the film and Na Woon-gyu.
[Tags] SungshinWomensUniversityStation, JeongneungHill, ArirangMovieStreet, ThemedStreet, Cinema, Culture
[Address] Jeongneung-dong, Seongbuk-gu, Seoul
[Subway information] Subway Line 4, Sungshin Women's University Station, Exits 5/6,  500m
[Important note] From Sungshin Women's University, follow the markers to Arirang Movie Street (1.5km) towards Jeongneung-dong. The area underwent urban renewal in the late 90s and Arirang Movie Street was established in 1999 to honor the pioneering Korean film legend, Na Woon-gyu. Na wrote and directed one of the earliest Korean films, Arirang (1926). Filming took place where Arirang Movie Street stands today. Walk along Arirang Movie Street to see Korean movie posters, Na Woon-gyu Park, and the Arirang Cine-center.

[Summary] The Road of Wind is a large public art structure that functions both as art and an observatory.
[Description] The Road of Wind is a large public art structure that functions both as art and an observatory. The Road of Wind is a Yeouido landmark and from the structure, visitors can see landscapes of the city and the Hangang River. The Seoul Color Park is a public park that is decorated in multiple colors to represent the multiple facets of Seoul. There are scultpures and art decorating the area. Both the Road of Wind and the Seoul Color Park are located at the southern end of Mapodaegyo Bridge.

[설명] JYP 엔터테인먼트(JYP Entertainment)는 대한민국을 대표하는 종합 엔터테인먼트 기업 중 하나로, 가수 박진영(J.Y. Park)에 의해 1997년에 설립되었습니다. JYP는 '성실, 겸손, 인내'를 핵심 가치로 삼으며, 글로벌 시장에서 활약하는 K-팝 아티스트들을 지속적으로 배출해왔습니다. JYP는 뛰어난 트레이닝 시스템과 철저한 아티스트 관리로 유명하며, 음악, 퍼포먼스, 인성까지 아우르는 전인적 아티스트 양성을 지향합니다. 이 회사는 아시아는 물론 북미, 유럽 등 전 세계 음악 팬들에게 사랑받는 아티스트들을 배출해왔습니다. 대표적인 소속 아티스트로는 2PM , GOT7 , TWICE , Stray Kids , ITZY , NMIXX 등이 있으며, 이들은 K-팝의 세계화를 이끄는 중심에 서 있습니다. 또한 JYP는 글로벌 사업 확장을 통해 미국과 중국 등지에 현지 법인을 설립하고, 글로벌 오디션 프로그램 및 협업 프로젝트 등을 통해 세계 시장을 겨냥한 콘텐츠를 꾸준히 제작하고 있습니다. 음악뿐만 아니라 드라마, 예능 등 다양한 콘텐츠 제작 및 매니지먼트 사업에도 참여하고 있으며, 팬과의 소통을 중시하는 기업 문화로 많은 팬들의 신뢰를 얻고 있습니다.

[설명] 국립현대미술관 서울관은 민현준 건축가에 의해 설계되어 '문화의 거리' 삼청로에 2013년 11월 개관하였습니다. 서울관 부지는 조선시대 소격서, 종친부, 규장각, 사간원이 있던 자리로서 한국 전쟁 후에는 국군수도통합병원, 기무사 등이 위치했던 역사적 유래를 가진 정치, 문화의 중심지입니다. 국립현대미술관 서울관은 전시동 및 교육동을 비롯하여 디지털정보실, 멀티프로젝트홀, 영화관 등 다양한 시설을 갖춘 복합문화예술센터입니다. 현대미술의 흐름을 한 눈에 볼 수 있는 다채로운 전시와 영화, 공연, 교육 등을 통해 다양한 장르의 문화예술을 만날 수 있습니다. 또한 마당으로 둘러싸인 서울관은 옛 기무사 건물과 종친부가 조화를 이루고, 멀리 겸재 정선의 인왕제색도 안에 담긴 인왕산의 모습도 감상할 수 있습니다. 어렵게만 느껴졌던 동시대 현대미술을 누구나 즐길 수 있는 곳, 국립현대미술관 서울관에서 문화예술 향유의 즐거움을 느껴보세요.

[설명] 국내 최초의 돔구장으로 주목받고 있는 고척 스카이돔은 2015년 9월에 착공된 돔형 야구장으로 사계절 내내 체육·문화행사를 즐길 수 있는 복합체육문화시설입니다. 지하 2층, 지상 4층으로 이뤄진 돔 형태의 건물로 천장이 막혀있어 날씨의 영향을 받지 않고, 야구경기 시설을 비롯해 수영장, 헬스장, 축구장, 농구장, 각종 편의시설을 갖춰 일반시민들도 이용할 수 있습니다. 관중석은 총 1만8천석으로 콘서트 같은 공연에서는 최대 2만200명의 관객을 수용할 수 있어, 야구경기 뿐 아니라 문화예술행사장으로도 각광받고 있습니다. 2016년부터 2017년까지 한국 프로야구단 넥센 히어로즈 팀이 홈구장으로 사용합니다. 국내 실내 공연장 중 최대 관객을 수용할 수 있는 고척 스카이돔은 야구경기가 없는 비시즌에는 각종 콘서트와 이벤트, 시상식 등이 열리는 문화예술시설로 인기를 얻고 있습니다. 2015년 그룹 EXO의 콘서트를 시작으로, 해외 유명 DJ들의 카니발 공연, 한국의 인기가수들이 총 출동한 KBS 가요대축제 등 대형공연이 성황리에 열리기도 했습니다. 고척 스카이돔에 대해 자주 묻는 질문 고척 스카이돔과 가까운 지하철역은 어디인가요? 고척 스카이돔과 가까운 지하철역은 구일역(1호선)입니다. 고척 스카이돔 내 매점이 있나요? 고척스카이돔 내에는 치킨, 분식, 피자, 편의점 등의 내부 매점(32개소)과 외부 관리동 매점(1개소)이 마련되어 있어 야구 관람 시 이용할 수 있습니다. (2026년 기준) 고척스카이돔 내에 음식물 반입이 가능한가요? 고척스카이돔의 음식물 반입은 행사 성격에 따라 제한이 될 수 있습니다. 프로야구 경기 시 음식물 및 1L 이하의 페트병에 든 음료는 반입할 수 있습니다. 다만, 주류 및 캔, 유리에 든 음료는 반입이 불가합니다. 또한 키움 히어로즈의 자체 규정에 따라 경기장 재입장 시 음식물 반입이 불가능합니다.

[Summary] Gocheok Skydome is the largest capacity stadium in South Korea. In addition to sporting events, arts events such as concerts and awards ceremonies are also often held here.
[Description] Gocheok Skydome is the largest capacity stadium in South Korea. In addition to sporting events, arts events such as concerts and awards ceremonies are also often held here. The stadium was completed in September, 2015 and is a cultural sports complex that is open year round. During the baseball season, visitors can watch exciting games and enjoy Korean baseball culture. During the off-season, there are concerts and other cultural events held at Gocheok. The stadium's design is dome-shaped and there are 2 basement levels and 4 above-ground levels. Thanks to its ceiling cover, games and events are unaffected by weather conditions. There are baseball facilities, a swimming pool, gym, soccer field, basketball field and many other facilities open for public use. The stands have 18,000 seats, but for cultural events like concerts, audiences of 20,200 can be accommodated. Gocheok Skydome is the home stadium for the Nexen Heroes from 2016 to 2017. G ocheok Skydome's size makes it one of the largest indoor concert venues in South Korea. The stadium has hosted many K-pop concerts and awards shows such as the KBS Music Awards and more. [Place] Naksan Park at Night
[Category] Culture > Parks
[Summary] See the Seoul City Wall and beautiful views of downtown Seoul at Naksan Park.
[Description] Naksan Park, located in Jongo-gu, is a great place to see the Seoul City Wall and take in views of downtown Seoul. The park is famous for the beauty of its nighttime views and the city wall. Seoul during the Joseon Dynasty was smaller than it is today. At the time, there were four mountains that were contained within the city limits, Naksan Mountain being one of them. Of the four mountains, Naksan was the smallest at just over 100m tall. The city wall that is along Naksan Mountain is divided by Hyehwamun Gate, Dongdaemun Gate, and Daehak-ro. For visitors that like to hike, they should take the Seoul City Wall trail from Hyehwamun to Dongdaemun or vice versa. If they prefer an easier route, they can begin the walk at Daehak-ro. Additionally, the park has been used as a filming location for many Hallyu dramas due to its beautiful scenary. Walk the old city wall and take in the beatiful twinkling lights of Seoul at Naksan Park. Frequently Asked Questions about Naksan Park How much is parking at Naksan Park? The parking fee at Naksan Park is 300 KRW per 10 minutes, and the parking can accommodate 29 cars. Since the parking lot is limited, it is recommended to inquire in advance (02-743-7985). (As of 2024) How much is the entrance fee to Naksan Park? Naksan Park is open to all and free of charge. Can I enter Naksan Park 24 hours a day? Yes. Naksan Park is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

document_title: The 18 Sparkling Bridges of the Han River
document_text:
[Place] The 18 Sparkling Bridges of the Han River
[Category] Festivals/Events/Performances > Festivals
[Summary] Just 12 of Seoul's bridges were lit up decoratively at night but lighting systems have expanded to 18 of Seoul's bridges.
[Description] The 18 Colorful Charms of the Han River at Nighttime Previously, for energy conservation reasons, only 12 of the Han River’s bridges were lit up colorfully at night. However, lighting plans were expanded to include more bridges and now a total of 18 Han River bridges are lit up colorfully at night. This has resulted in an even more beautiful Seoul nightscape. Currently, 27 of the Han River’s 29 bridges have or are in the process of being fitted with lighting systems. Originally, just 12 bridges had lighting systems. The 6 bridges to have been newly fitted with lighting systems are the Hangang Railway Bridge, the Haengjydaegyo Bridge, the Dongjakdaegyo Bridge, the Hannamdaegyo Bridge, the Yeongdongdaegyo Bridge, and the Jamsildaegyo Bridge. The 5 “storytelling” bridges and the 13 “outstanding landscape” bridges each have their own personalities, images, and characteristics. The light show times are flexible. The exact time the bridges’ decorative lighting turns on varies depending on the season and sunset times. Usually, the lights go on from dark until 11pm. Additionally, from May to October, the warm weather draws many Seoulites to the Han River and so the lights are usually kept on until midnight during these months.
[Tags] Han River, Hannamdaegyo Bridge, Yeongdongdaegyo Bridge, Seongsandaegyo Bridge, Banpodaegyo Bridge,  Jamsildaegyo Bridge,  Olympic Bridge, Nighttime Spot

[요약] 국립현대미술관과 현대자동차의 협업으로 탄생한 갤러리 아트존
[설명] 갤러리 아트존(Gallery Art Zone)은 국립현대미술관 서울관 내 1층 570㎡ 규모로 3개존 5개 공간으로 구성되어 있습니다. 국립현대미술관과 현대자동차의 협업으로 탄생한 갤러리 아트존은 문화상품 발굴, 차세대 작가들의 전시 및 상품제작 등을 통해 관람객들과의 보다 폭 넓은 소통의 장으로 예술의 문턱을 낮춰 문화저변을 확대해나가고 있습니다. 갤러리 아트존(Gallery Art Zone)은 동시대 문화예술의 다양한 면모와 무궁무진함을 3개의 존에서 선보입니다. 제1구역(갤러리 1)은 국내 작가와 그들의 작품, 특히 공예분야의 유망한 작가들의 작품들을 지속적으로 전시판매 하는 공간이며, 제2구역(갤러리 2, 3)은 미술관에서 개발하는 문화상품과 도록, 디자인 아이디어 제품들을 전시판매하고 있고, 제3구역(갤러리 4, 5)에서는 섬유·패션 상품 및 국내외 미술전문서적 등을 판매하고있습니다. 특히, 현대자동차가 후원하는 아트 콜라보레이션의 결과물들을 이곳에서 선보이며 미술관 관련 이벤트와 특별행사들을 꾸준히 기획하여 진행하고 있습니다.

document_title: Gallery Art Zone at the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art
document_text:
[Place] Gallery Art Zone at the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Art Museums/Galleries
[Summary] The Gallery Art Zone was borne out of a collaboration with the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (MMCA) and Hyundai Motor Company.
[Description] The Gallery Art Zone is located on the 1st floor of MMCA and is about 570㎡ in size There are three zones and five gallery spaces. The Gallery Art Zone was borne out of a collaboration with the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art (MMCA) and Hyundai Motor Company. The Gallery Art Zone’s aim is to expand the breadth of audiences when it comes to art. Art shouldn’t just be for walls and showcases. The works on display in the Gallery Art Zone can be bought, and regular visitors can bring a piece of art or design home. The Gallery Art Zone shows different aspects of Korean contemporary art and design in each zone. The first zone (Gallery 1) exhibits Korean design and sells works by promising artists, particularly those from the craft sector. The second zone (Galleries 2 and 3) exhibits and sells cultural products that were developed for MMCA, or on display at MMCA. The third zone (Galleries 4 and 5) displays and sells textiles, fashion products, and art books. Additionally, in part as a result of Hyundai Motor Company’s sponsorship, many art related events and special events will be held at the Gallery Art Zone.

[Summary] Where the Joseon dynasty's family business of etching gold leaf on royal silk
[Description] Geumbakyeon is a place that has passed down the history of the royal family for five generations, from the royal goldsmith during the reign of King Cheoljong in 1856 to Kim Ki-ho, the national intangible cultural property No. 119. Since ancient times, gold has symbolized eternal beauty due to its unchanging light, and the royal family used gold foil to engrave patterns on their clothes. Geumbaekyeon maintains a unique traditional technique of coating gold leaf using woodblocks designed and produced by craftsmen, and promotes Korean gold leaf art by applying traditional gold leaf techniques to various materials. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr/main/mainForm.do )

Inspired by the movements and forms of living creatures, the artfully expressed objects invite visitors to escape reality and experience their own fantasies.

document_title: Children's Museum of the National Museum of Korea
document_text:
[Place] Children's Museum of the National Museum of Korea
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Museums
[Summary] The Children's Museum of the National Museum of Korea showcases the cultural heritage of Korea.
[Description] The Children's Museum of the National Museum of Korea showcases the cultural heritage of Korea. The Children's Museum is located within the National Museum of Korea. Children can learn about the way of life and wisdom of people in ancient times through fun activities and exhibits. There is a reproduction of an ancient Korean house from the Goguryeo era and even a reproduction of a pottery workshop and kiln on display. Additionally, children can even try on historical clothing, accessories, and golden crowns. The museum exhibits reproductions of artifacts that are on display in the National Museum of Korea. Children will be able to learn and gain a deeper understanding of Korean cultural heritage through fun, hands-on experiences.

[Summary] The National Palace Museum of Korea showcases 500 years of history with roughly 45,000 artifacts from the Joseon Dynasty.
[Description] The National Palace Museum of Korea showcases 500 years of history with roughly 45,000 artifacts from the Joseon Dynasty. Artifacts on display include texts and poems that were handwritten by kings of the past, robes worn by royalty, jewelry, and other items from the royal courts of Korea. Highlights from the museum collection are many, one highlight is the royal vehicle of Emperor Sunjong, the last king of the Joseon Dynasty. Another highlight of the colelction is the rain gauge pedestal. The rain gauge pedestal was an invention that dated back to the Joseon era. The museum also offers a learning program called "Experiencing Royal Culture;" the program is suitable for people of all ages. [Place] Baek In-je House
[Category] History > Historical Sites > Others Historical Sites
[Summary] Baek Inje's House is a museum and cultural heritage site located in Bukchon Hanok Village's Gahoe-dong.
[Description] The Baek Inje’s House, located in Gahoe-dong, Bukchon, is a representative traditional house that well preserves the style of modern hanok architecture. Although built during the Japanese occupation period, it has been designated as a Seoul Metropolitan Folklore Cultural Heritage due to its good condition and its blend of traditional hanok beauty with modern adaptations. Situated on a plot overlooking Bukchon, the property features a spacious Anchae (main living quarters) and a large garden centered around the Sarangchae (men's quarters), with a small Byeoldangchae (detached quarters) on the highest point. In this quiet, traditional setting, visitors can glimpse the lifestyle of the wealthy class of that era and observe features that distinguish it from typical upper-class homes of the time. Detailed information on the Baek Inje’s House, including its history, context, and characteristics, is available in the Haengnangchae (servants' quarters) and small Sarangbang (guest reception room). While general tours don't require reservations, entry to some areas like the Sarangchae and Byeoldangchae is only for those with guided tour bookings. ※ Baek In-je (1898 - Unknown): Baek In-je was a Korean patriot who fought for Korean independence during the Japanese colonial era. Baek was also a doctor who devoted much of his time to studying rickets and blood disorders.

[Place] Sungnyemun Gate (Namdaemun)
[Category] History > Historical Sites > Fortresses & Gates
[Summary] Sungnyemun Gate (Namdaemun) is one of Seoul's historic Four Great Gates and it was designated National Treasure no. 1 by the Korean government in 1962.
[Description] Sungnyemun Gate (Namdaemun) is one of Seoul's historic Four Great Gates and it was designated National Treasure no. 1 by the Korean government in 1962. Though its official name is Sungnyemun, it is also popularly known as Namdaemun Gate due to its location at what was once the southern end of Seoul. As the centuries passed, Seoul grew in size but Sungnyemun Gate has endured through the ages. Construction on the gate was started in 1395 and completed in 1398. In 1447, Sungnyemun saw reconstruction work carried out. The gate is the largest city gate with an arched entrance in the city, and atop the gate's wooden base stands a 2-story wooden structure. The gate is Seoul's oldest wooden structure but on Feb. 10th, 2008, much of the gate's wooden structure was destroyed by fire. Following several years of restorative work, Sungnyemun Gate can now be enjoyed in all its glory. ​

[Place] SeMA Nam June Paik Memorial House
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Museums
[Summary] A space commemorating the life and art of Nam June Paik
[Description] The SeMA Nam June Paik Memorial House is a space that commemorates the artist Nam June Paik (1932~2006). Built on the site of the house where the world-renowned artist spent his childhood from 1937 to 1950, the Nam June Paik Memorial House restores the original single-story traditional Korean hanok house built in 1960 to trace the internationally acclaimed artist’s origins. The Nam June Paik Cafe, operated by local residents, provides a comfortable space for visitors to rest.

[Description] Seoullo 7017 is an elevated sky garden that is a popular walking destination and tourist spot in the center of Seoul. Originally a highway overpass, it has since been transformed into a pedestrian walkway for the general public to enjoy. Seoullo 7017 offers several rest areas, greenery, and cultural experiences at 1 kilometer above street-level.

[Description] The Oil Tank Culture Park is a park and cultural complex located in Mapo-gu, Seoul. The park was originally an oil depot. [Place] Sewoon Shopping Center
[Category] History > Historical Sites > Others Historical Sites
[Summary] The Sewoon Shopping Center was founded in 1968 as Korea's first electronics market under the mission of creating a thriving business community complex and has been around for over 40 years.
[Description] The Sewoon Shopping Center was founded in 1968 as Korea's first electronics market under the mission of creating a thriving business community complex and has been around for over 40 years. The center reached its height during the 1970s & 80s as Korea's "go-to" electronics market but has also experienced a few low points along the way. However, in 2017, the Dasi Sewoon Project advocated for the second rise of the market as a "Maker City" that embraces both the creative manufacturing and creative printing industries. The market offers not only a wide selection of electronics and electrical products such as appliances, parts, audio devices, security cameras, arcade games, karaoke equipment and lighting equipment, but it is also home to a variety of other sites and attractions, such as the Sewoon Rooftop where Seoul's past and present converge into a single panoramic view, the sky-deck walkway, which is open to the public and crosses the Cheonggyecheon Stream, Sewoon Hall, a culture complex celebrating Joseon Dynasty cultural values, and the Cheonggye Sanghoe, a market filled with items specific to different regions and communities throughout the country.

[Place] Sukjeongmun Gate

[Summary] Sukjeongmun Gate is one of Seoul’s four historic great city gates. It is the city's northern gate and it can be visited today along the Hanyangdoseong, Seoul City Wall.
[Description] Sukjeongmun Gate is one of Seoul’s four historic great city gates. It is the city's northern gate and it can be visited today along the Hanyangdoseong, Seoul City Wall. Cheong Wa Dae, the official residence of the South Korean president is located not far from the gate and city wall. For decades, public access to the gate and its section of the city wall was restricted for security reasons. In 2006, public access to this section of the Hanyangdoseong was restored and it is now a very popular hiking destination. On January 21st, 1963, Sukjeongmun was recognized as part of the Hanyangdoseong, Seoul City Wall and designated Historic Site No. 10.

[카테고리] 쇼핑 > 전문매장/상가
[요약] 특별한 미식과 새로운 라이프스타일, 식문화 트렌드를 경험할 수 있는 복합 식문화 공간.
[설명] 2018년 6월 1일에 문을 연 서울에서 가장 ‘핫’한 곳 중 하나. 특별한 미식과 새로운 라이프스타일, 식문화 트렌드를 경험할 수 있는 복합 식문화 공간입니다. CJ제일제당의 모든 가정 간편식 브랜드 제품부터 해외 유명 브랜드 식재료까지 한꺼번에 쇼핑하고, 즉석에서 맛도 볼 수 있습니다. 정문을 열고 들어갔을 때 왼쪽에는 브랜드 스토어인 ‘올리브 그로서리’가, 오른쪽에는 레스토랑인 ‘올리브 델리’가 있습니다. 올리브 그로서리에서는 CJ제일제당의 가정 간편식제품과 신선한 식재료들을 보고, 즐기고, 쇼핑할 수 있습니다. 올리브 델리에서는 전문 셰프가 CJ제일제당의 가정 간편식 제품에 제철 식재료를 더해 개발한 외식 메뉴를 맛볼 수 있습니다. 이곳의 또 다른 특징은 세련된 ‘토핑 바’이다. 조식시간에 방문하면 CJ가정간편식 자판기에서 햇반 컵반을 구매한 후 무료로 자신의 입맛에 맞게 계란지단, 콩나물, 대파 슬라이스 등 각종 토핑들을 햇반 컵반에 얹어 먹을 수 있습니다. CJ가정간편식 자판기도 지나쳐서는 안 됩니다. 흔히 볼 수 있는 햇반 컵반이 아닌 무려 ‘박보검 에디션’이라는 사실! 인스타그램에서 품절 여부를 따로 안내해줄 정도로 인기가 많으니, 헛걸음하지 않기 위해서는 미리 확인하도록 하세요.

[Place] Myung Sin Dang Brush Store
[Category] Experience Programs > Craft Workshops
[Summary] A store of four treasures of the study that grew up with artists
[Description] Myeongsindang Pilbang was founded in 1932 in Boryeong, Chungcheongnam-do, as an ink factory and moved to Insadong in 1987, where it has remained ever since. It is one of the few remaining paintbrush shops and is also famous for inscription which was carved by Queen Elizabeth and the King and Queen of Spain during their visit to Korea. Myeongsin-dang Pilbang's trade name, "Myeongsin," means "always moving forward, day by day and month by month. Top Korean calligraphers such as Idang Kim Eun-ho, Cheongjeon Lee Sang-beom, Sojung Byeon-kwan-sik, and Goam Lee Eung-no all purchased materials from Guhasanbang. Myeongshindang Pilbang is not only concerned with preserving tradition, but is also constantly researching new materials.

[Summary] The Korea’s oldest bookstore with national treasure-level cultural artifacts
[Description] Tongmungwan is an old bookstore that opened in 1934, and has been opening for three generations. It is a bookstore that discovers, evaluates, analyzes, distributes, and publishes ancient Korean books, and has discovered numerous cultural assets such as "Wolin Seokbo" and "Independent Newspaper." [Description] Gongpyeong Historic Sites Museum was created when well preserved 16th century Joseon sites were dug up during redevelopment phases of Gongpyeong district 1, 2, and 4. [Place] Seoul Botanic Park

[Summary] Located in Magok, Gangseo-gu, Seoul Botanic Park is the first facility in Seoul to combine both a botanical garden and a park in one space.
[Description] Located in Magok, Gangseo-gu, Seoul Botanic Park is the first facility in Seoul to combine botanical garden and park in one space. A space where a forest, garden, lake, and marsh coexist together, Seoul Botanic Park's theme zone houses plants representing 12 major cities around the world. Within close distance from Gimpo Airport (10 minute) and Incheon Airport (40 minute), Seoul Botanic Park is also directly connected with the subway station, allowing visitors to easily access its facilities. Seoul Botanic Park was created to advance the urban ecology of Seoul and will display plants from 12 cities around the world. As part of an effort to expand green spaces around the city, this facility offers educational programs on top of hosting cultural events, serving as a space where city residents can get back in touch with nature. Frequently Asked Questions about Seoul Botanic Park Can I bring my pets to the Seoul Botanic Park? Only pets with leashes, name tags, and toilet bags are allowed to enter. However, pets are not permitted inside the theme gardens and plant culture center. However, guide dogs are an exception. (As of 2024) When is Seoul Botanical Garden closed? The Seoul Botanic Park’s Forest Field, Lake Garden, and Wetland are open year-round, and the Theme gardens and greenhouse are closed every Monday.

[Place] Seoraeseom Island
[Category] Nature > Natural Sites(Rivers)
[Summary] Seoraeseom Island is a small artificial island located between Dongjakdaegyo Bridge and Banpodaegyo Bridge.
[Description] Seoraeseom Island is a small artificial island located between Dongjakdaegyo Bridge and Banpodaegyo Bridge. Although it's an island, it's located closer to the river banks, making it easily accessible via the 3 bridges connecting it to Banpo Hangang Park. Featuring magnificent weeping willows and widespread canola flower fields during springtime, this site is commonly used for natural and environmental research. Unlike other sites which take advantage of their higher vantage points to attract visitors, Seoraeseom Island takes advantage of it being on the same surface level as Hangang River, offering visitors spectacular views of the city's buildings and sunsets.

[Place] Bongsan Mountain
[Category] Nature > Natural Sites(Mountains)
[Summary] Located between Seoul's Eunpyeong-gu and Gyeonggi-do's Goyang, Bongsan Mountain outlines the edge of Western Seoul.
[Description] Bongsan Mountain, located between Eunpyeong-gu, Seoul and Goyang, Gyeonggi-do, is the mountain that marks the boundary of western of Seoul. Although it is not very tall, at only 209 meters, it is not necessarily an easy hiking course as there are quite a few steep hills. Pavilions that are named Bongsudae and Bongsujeong are located at the top of Bongsan Mountain. From the top of the mountain, visitors can enjoy the beautiful sunset over the Hangang River, which reflects the vibrant colors on the water. The most popular course is the Bongsan Sunrise Trail. Sunrise Park is located at the top of Bongsan Mountain where visitors can enjoy a beautiful view of Eunpyeong-gu, Seoul. Additionally, on the Bongsan Sunrise Trail course, there is Hyguksa Temple, a Korean temple made of pure gold. Even in the daytime, it shines beautifully, but at sunset, the golden sky and the temple come together to create a dazzling landscape.

[Summary] A traditional oriental medicine clinic offering acupuncture and herbal medicine prescriptions
[Description] Yuil Oriental Medicine Clinic was founded in 1945 by Dr. Lee Taek-sung, the father of the current president, and has remained in the same location ever since. The Jongno-gu area was originally densely populated with oriental medicine clinics and herbal medicine shops, and at one point there were 300 of them. Today, the number of clinics has decreased, but the only cli nic still stands. It is the 'only' oriental medicine clinic, as the name suggests, that has been practicing the old acupuncture methods that are different from other clinics. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)

[Place] Haechang Tailor Shop

[Summary] Haechang Tailor shop is Sogong-dong’s oldest tailor shop with over 90 years of history.
[Description] Haechang Tailor shop is Sogong-dong’s oldest tailor shop with over 90 years of history. Having started its origin in Bosu-dong, Busan back in 1929, it moved locations to Sogong-dong, Seoul in 1945 and developed an impressive list of clientele including many historical figures in Korea. Haechang Tailor Shop was a beloved shop of many prominent political figures in Korean history. This shop was able continue to maintain business due to their high quality service and suits. Through constant communication with their customers, the shop make suits that accurately reflect the individual customer's style through details. One of Korea's first tailor shop, many students who used to learn and work in this store has set up their own tailor shops throughout Korea.

[Place] HONGIKMUNGO
[Category] Shopping > Specialty Shops & Stores
[Summary] A popular hangout in Sinchon and Seoul's oldest bookstore
[Description] Hongik Books started as a street vendor in 1957 and has become a Sinchon landmark for over 60 years, making it South Korea's oldest bookstore. It was once a popular meeting spot in Sinchon. The bookstore moved to its current building in 1978, initially using only the first and second floors, and expanded to occupy the entire building in 1984. Now in its second generation of family operation, Hongik Books takes its name from the Hongik Ingan philosophy, which means "to benefit humanity broadly." The bookstore is dedicated to serving customers, partners, employees, and family. In front of Hongik Books is "Literary Street," which features the handprints of 15 prominent Korean writers and hosts romantic street piano concerts. • This place has been selected as a 'Seoul Future Heritage'. Among Seoul's modern and contemporary cultural heritage, Seoul Future Heritage is a tangible and intangible asset that is worth passing on to future generations.( https://futureheritage.seoul.go.kr)

[Summary] Literally meaning "liberated village", Haebangchon is a popular attraction that was once made up of empty market spaces and alleyways before it underwent urban regeneration.
[Description] Literally meaning "liberated village", Haebangchon is a popular attraction that was once made up of empty market spaces and alleyways before it underwent urban regeneration. Connected to Namsan Mountain, the upper areas of this sloped village are hard to reach but worth the climb for its beautiful panoramic views. It is frequently visited not only by tourists and travelers, but also old residents and people from all walks of life. As Itaewon became popular in the mid-2000s, Haebangchon also started gaining attention from people passing by. Because of the gentrification of Gangnam, Hongdae, and Itaewon, Haebangchon began to transform into a gathering place for aspiring young artists and creators. The area is full of unique little workshops, cafes, and bookstores. Meanwhile, cafes and restaurant with a more sophisticated atmosphere have been appearing near the street of Sinheung-ro, continuing to bring in many more visitors to the area.

[Description] Itaewon Antique Furniture Street is the first place in Korea to sell antique furniture. [Place] Donuimun Museum
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Museums
[Summary] A new cultural space constructed from old buildings, located in Saemunan.
[Description] Donuimun Museum is a new cultural space constructed from old restaurant buildings located in the old neighborhood of Saemunan. Originally built as residential homes back in 1960, these buildings were used as restaurants from 1990 to 2000, some of which included Italian restaurant AGIO and Korean restaurant Hanjeong. While preserving the architecture of the old structure, the buildings were reinforced for safety during their renovation into exhibition spaces. Located in a central location within Saemunan surrounded by Seoul City Wall and the walls of Gyeonghuigung Palace, the spaces inhabited by AGIO and Hanjeong hold great historical and cultural value. When portions of Gyeonghuigung Palace Wall were discovered underground, the site has been transformed to preserve and display the remains. At Donuimun Museum, visitors can learn about the culture and history surrounding the area around it. [Place] Mugyewon
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Others Cultural Facilities
[Summary] Located in Buam-dong, Jongno-gu, Mugyewon is a cultural space where visitors can go to enjoy the traditional and cultural beauty of Korea in a hanok experience.
[Description] Mugyewon is a traditional cultural space located in Buam-dong, Jongno-gu. It is a restored hanok, reconstructed using materials from Ojinam, the first registered restaurant in Seoul. Nestled at the foot of Inwangsan Mountain, visitors can experience the serene beauty of Korean architecture and appreciate the tranquil scenery. The site of Mugyewon, known as Mugaejeongsa, was the villa of Grand Prince Anpyeong, the third son of King Sejong. Inspired by its resemblance to the utopian paradise he saw in a dream, Grand Prince Anpyeong built a pavilion where he composed poetry and practiced archery. This historically significant location is also where An Gyeon, the foremost painter of the time, created the famous "Dream Journey to the Peach Blossom Land" in just three days. Since its opening in 2014, Mugyewon has offered a variety of cultural programs, including performances, exhibitions, lectures, education, and hands-on experiences. If you wish to experience Korean tradition and culture amidst scenery as beautiful as the mythical Peach Blossom Land, we recommend visiting this place.

[Description] Hwanghakjeong is an archery field built by Emperor Gojong who strongly believed that archery was the best activity for training one's body and spirit. [Summary] A valley with cool, clear water, Uidong Valley is located between Dobongsan Mountain and Bukhansan Mountain.
[Description] The Ui-dong Valley, a notable valley in Gangbuk, is situated between Dobongsan and Bukhansan mountains. It features scattered waterfalls and ponds, with a long stream flowing from the entrance to Baegundae, the gentlest course in Bukhansan Mountain. While swimming is prohibited due to its location within Bukhansan National Park, simply sitting on a rock and breathing in the refreshing air is enough to beat the heat. The valley is well-equipped with amenities such as stairs and walking paths, enhancing convenience. Moreover, spending time at the nearby restaurants and cafes is delightful. Its proximity to downtown Seoul and easy access via public transportation make it a favored destination for Seoul residents.

[Place] Seosomun Historical Park
[Category] History > Historical Sites > Others Historical Sites
[Summary] Seosomun Historical Park includes a total area of 46,000 m².
[Description] Formerly Seosomun Neighborhood Park, Seosomun Historical Park is a park which underwent renovation in 2019 to include 4 basement levels, totaling an area of 46,000 m². The ground level features the park and its facilities while the basement levels feature memorial halls, Sky Square, educational centers, facilities, and parking lot. During the park's renovation process, the mausoleum built back in 1984 was preserved on ground level and a plaza was placed in the center of the park surrounded by plant life, including 45 different species of trees (pine, oak, rose bush), and 100,000 stems of 33 different species of grass and reed such as iris, pink mulley, and silver grass, transforming the site into a cultural "healing" space. The basement levels of the park are consist of a memorial hall, a historical memorial hall, convenience facilities, education centers, and a parking lot. Specifically, the B1 level holds a library, seminar rooms, memorial souvenir shop and cafe, facility, and amenities for visitors. The B2 - B3 level is made up of a Sky Square and an exhibition hall. Although Sky Square, a memorial hall to commemorate the martyrs who've sacrificed themselves, is located on the basement floor, it has no ceiling so that visitors can look up to see the sky.

[카테고리] 자연관광
[요약] 용산구 한강대교 중간에 위치한 음악과 미술이 공존하는 복합문화공간
[설명] 용산구 한강대교 중간에 위치한 노들섬은 음악과 미술이 공존하는 복합문화공간입니다. 노들섬에는 라이브하우스, 노들갤러리, 노들서가, 노들라운지, 다목적홀 숲 등의 시설이 있습니다. 노들섬에 대해 자주 묻는 질문 노들섬 운영시간이 어떻게 되나요? 노들섬 운영시간은 아래와 같습니다. (2025년 기준) • 하절기(3월~10월) : 화요일~금요일 10:00~21:00 / 주말 및 공휴일 10:00~22:00 • 동절기(11월~2월) : 화요일~일요일 10:00~20:00 • 야외공간 : 24시간 개방 ※ 매주 월요일은 휴관이며, 개별 시설마다 운영시간이 다를 수 있습니다. 노들섬에는 어떤 시설이 있나요? 공연장, 공원, 다목적홀, 사무공간, 서점, 음식점 등 다양한 시설이 있습니다. 자세한 정보는 아래 홈페이지를 통해 확인할 수 있습니다. 노들섬 시설 층별 안내 노들섬에 반려동물 동반 출입이 가능한가요? 반려동물은 목줄 또는 케이지를 이용하여 동반 출입할 수 있습니다. 다만, 실내 공간은 입장이 불가합니다. (2025년 기준)

[Description] Located under the Han River Bridge connecting Yongsan and Noryangjin, Nodeul Island is a cultural space with a great focus on nature, books, and music. (As of 2025) • Summer season (March-October) : Tuesday-Friday 10:00~21:00 / Weekends and holidays 10:00~22:00 • Winter season (November-February) : Tuesday-Sunday 10:00~20:00 • Outdoor space: open 24 hours ※ Closed on Mondays, and each facility may have different operating hours. What kind of facilities are there on Nodeul Island? There are various facilities such as concert hall, gallery, lounge, multi-purpose hall, restaurants, and more. You can check the detailed information on the website below. Nodeul Island facilities floor guide Are pets allowed on Nodeul Island? Pets are permitted if on a leash or in a cage. However, admission to the indoor space is not allowed. (As of 2054)

[Description] Jeungsan Market is made up of 180 stores including hardware stores, restaurants, and stores selling fresh produce, dairy, and fish. Famous for their 30 year old sundaeguk (blood sausage), this market houses about 10 different stores dedicated to this dishin its central area. In 2017, several youth projects were selected for a “Residents Participatory Budgeting Project," which led to opening up stores such as “Flower Tea Love Potion” and “Brothers’ Bar”, bringing back a renewed vitality to the market’s atmosphere.

[Summary] A store run by a human cultural asset where intellectuals, artists, and professors visit

document_title: Opening of Seoul Museum of Korean Folk Music
document_text:
[Place] Opening of Seoul Museum of Korean Folk Music
[Category] Festivals/Events/Performances > Festivals
[Summary] A museum offering a rich collection of sounds of Korea, along with exhibition halls, listening rooms, and educational spaces.
[Description] A petite hanok building located on the site of the Border Defense Council of Joseon at the junction in front of Changdeokgung Palace on Donhwamum-ro. The building is Seoul Museum of Korean Folk Music where everyone can experience and enjoy the melodies of Korean folk music. The sound of farmers singing through strenuous farm work, the sound of fishers yanking fishing nets wishing for a full load of fish, the sound of women humming softly as they weaved hemp clothes, and the folk songs that have been passed from mouth to mouth. This is a place where you can listen to the unfamiliar yet comforting sounds to your heart's desire. The Seoul Museum of Korean Folk Music was established for Korean citizens and tourists visiting Korea from overseas to enjoy the sound of Korea that the Seoul Metropolitan Government has collected so far including 20,000 pieces of Korean folk music and 5,700 pieces of musical instruments. If Seoul Donhwamun Traditional Theater which is located not far from the museum is the center of the traditional Korean court music, this place offers a comprehensive view of Korean folk music in a systematic manner. Through the Seoul Museum of Korean Folk Music, the preservation of Korean oral folk songs, which are harder to hear these days, is now possible.

[Place] Seoul Sewerage Science Museum

[Summary] A space centered on on-site experience comprised of a science exhibition hall that displays the history, technology, and future of the industry.
[Description] Established in 2017 to promote the history and science of sewerage, the Seoul Sewerage Science Museum is the nation's first science museum specializing in sewerage. It was constructed at the site of the Cheonggyecheon Sewage Treatment Plant, the country's first sewage disposal plant, to continue the historical significance and values of the facility. The museum is also a space that is centered on on-site experience, comprised of a science exhibition hall that displays the history, technology, and future of domestic and overseas sewerage, as well as a water reclamation center where visitors can take a look around sewerage facilities. As the center of environmental education, the Seoul Sewerage Science Museum offers various programs to teach the process of sewage purification and the significance of water.

document_text:
[Place] Sungshin Women's University Costume Museum and Natural History Museum
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Museums
[Summary] Located in the Woonjung Green Campus, the second campus of the Sungshin Women's University, invites visitors to learn about traditional Korean attires, as well as the history of nature.
[Description] Opened on November 23, 2011, the Park Kwang Hoon Costume Museum is a special museum, displaying over 600 garments, which are currently designated as Seoul's Intangible Cultural Property No. 11, donated by the Master Artisan of Needlework, Park Kwang Hoon, as well as more than 2,000 pieces of fabrics and accessories. A variety of Korean attires and accessories are on display, from swaddling clothes and ordinary clothes as well as wedding clothes and royal ritual clothes to shrouds for the deceased. Located in the basement (B1) of the same building, the Natural History Museum exhibits as many as 135,000 samples collected for over 40 years since the 1970s under four themes of rocks, embryogenesis, plants and insects to help visitors learn and feel the nature around them. ㆍ Park Kwang Hoon Costume Museum offers various arts and culture programs, including the traditional pattern gilt stamping class, traditional pattern drawing class, and jokduri making class, in addition to its main exhibitions. ※ Extra charges apply for experience programs.

[Place] Hwagyesa Temple
[Category] History > Religious Sites
[Summary] Hwagyesa Temple was founded by Seonsa (Seon master) Sinwol in 1522 (17th year of King Jungjong's reign).
[Description] Hwagyesa Temple was founded by Seonsa (Seon master) Sinwol in 1522 (17th year of King Jungjong's reign). Originally, Daesa (a high Buddhist priest) Beopin, or Tanmun, built a hermitage called Bodeokam near the site of Hwagyesa Temple, preserving long-standingBuddhist tradition. Later on, Seonsa Sinwol would move the hermitage to the current location and rename it Hwagyesa. During the Joseon Period, the royal family frequented the temple and Regent Heungseon Daewongun supported the temple during the latteryears of Joseon. A cradle of the enlightenment movement, Hwagyesa Temple produced a number of figures who embroiders the modern history of Korea, including Mubul and Cha Hong-sik, and is also known to have served as a place for monks who participated in the Gapsin Revolutionto prepare for the enlightenment movement. Hwagyesa Temple is a historic venue where the Korean Language Society organized a stay of nine Korean language scholars, including Lee Hui-seung and Choe Hyeon-bae, wherein they completed the Unified Korean Orthography in 1933. Recently, the temple becameinternationally known as being a center for worldwide propagation. In 1991, the Daejeokgwangjeon Hall was established and an international seonwoen (Seon monastery) was opened on the 4th floor to accommodate buddhists from other countries.

[설명] 서울도시건축전시관은 서울시가 2015년 광복 70주년을 맞아 일제강점기의 잔재였던 옛 국세청 별관 건물을 철거하고, 그 자리의 역사적 가치를 회복해 시민들에게 되돌려주는 『세종대로 일대 역사 문화 특화 공간 조성 사업』의 일환으로 설립한 전시관입니다. 국내 최초로 설립된 도시건축 분야 전문 전시관으로, 전시관은 지상 1층, 지하 3층(연면적 2,998㎡) 규모로 지상층에 시민광장을 조성하고 지하 3개 층을 전시관으로 조성했으며, 지하층은 지하 보행로를 통해 시민청과 연결됩니다. 서울의 도시발전과정과 미래 비전을 제시하고 시민 모두가 도시건축을 가까이하고 문화적 자산으로 인식할 수 있도록 도시·건축·공간 분야의 플랫폼이 될 것이며, 인구 천만이 넘는 메트로폴리스로서 세계 유수 도시와 정책·문화 교류를 통해 국제적 역량을 강화해 나아가고자 합니다. 더불어, 서울도시건축전시관이 또 하나의 시민 소통 공간, 문화향유 공간이 되기를 바라는 기대와 함께 이를 통해 서울이라는 도시의 형성 과정과 배경, 역사성과 지역성에 대한 이해를 도모하고 건축을 비롯한 공간환경의 진정한 의미와 가치를 전문가뿐 아니라 시민 누구나 함께 나누고 향유할 수 있는 시민 공간으로 자리매김하기를 바랍니다. 서울도시건축전시관은 도시, 건축, 환경 및 정책과 관련된 기획, 상설, 대관 전시를 진행하고, 관련 정보 수집 및 아카이빙, 계절, 연휴 등의 이슈와 관련된 시민 프로그램 진행 등을 합니다.

[Place] Seoul Hall of Urbanism & Architecture
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities
[Summary] Come share and experience in the exhibitions and events in store for the public to explore the urbanism and architecture industry while enjoying some leisure in the city.
[Description] In honor of the 70th anniversary of the nation's liberation from Japanese rule, the Seoul Hall of Urbanism & Architecture was erected as a part of the Sejong-daero Historic Culture Space Design Competition in the very spot where the annex to the tax office during the Japanese Occupation, one of the last remnants of the period, once stood. The competition had been held as a social contribution project to help restore the historical significance of the location. As Korea's very first urbanism and architecture specialized exhibition hall, it houses a total area of 2,998 m², spread between the first floor down to the third floor basement level. The first floor is comprised of a citizen's space, or public area, while the lower three basement levels are home to extensive galleries and have an underground walkway connecting with Seoul Citizens Hall. In accordance with Seoul's process of urban development and vision for the future, the hall is intended to be a platform for the urbanism and architecture industry so as to promote the value and public awareness of the industry as a cultural asset.

[Place] Seoul Hall of Urbanism & Architecture
[Primary category] Culture
[Secondary category] Cultural Facilities

and vision for the future, the hall is intended to be a platform for the urbanism and architecture industry so as to promote the value and public awareness of the industry as a cultural asset. Additionally, the hall is sought to bolster the city's capacities on a global scale as a metropolis with a ten million-plus population through becoming that of an influential city, as well as through an exchange of policy and culture. Being grounded in the aim to also establish the hall as both a communal and cultural space, the hope is to encourage the understanding of Seoul's origin and background, in addition to its historical and geographical value; while also establishing the hall as a public space that enables the sharing and appreciation of the city's true significance and value as an architectural feat among both specialists and everyday people. The Seoul Hall of Urbanism & Architecture currently operates special, permanent, and general exhibitions focused on the city, architecture, the urban environment, and policy, and runs several public programs that pertain to issues concerning the collection and archiving of such information, as well as theme-based events about the seasons, holidays, and much more.

[Place] Jeon Tae-il Memorial Hall
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Others Cultural Facilities
[Summary] The hall serves as a memorial for Jeon Tae-il to help the public better appreciate the historical and present-day significance of all those sacrificing themselves in the labor force.
[Description] Having been built by the Seoul city government, the Jeon Tae-il Memorial Hall is a labor complex facility erected to illuminate upon the historical significance of Jeon Tae-il, whose self-sacrifice served as a pivotal point in time in the history of the Korean labor movement. The young man gave everything he had to create a world that centered itself around the mentality that workers are people that have the right to live, work, and study in good health. In order to help bring Jeon Tae-il's dream into fruition, the hall urges unity between the labor force, the youth of the country, and the public, brought together around the ideals of love and solidarity.

[Summary] Enjoy the sweeping view of Namsan Mountain while riding the cable car to the summit!
[Description] The Namsan Cable Car is the most convenient and fun way to reach the summit of Namsan Mountain! In just a three-minute ride, you can reach the mountain peak up near the N Seoul Tower all the while enjoying a fantastic overlook of downtown Seoul. Not only can you experience the breathtaking view of the autumn foliage in the fall and snow-covered mountainside in the winter, but you can even catch a gorgeous aerial view of the city at night. Near the parking lot of the cable car, the surrounding neighborhood has a great selection of popular restaurants offering tasty menu items from tonkatsu (breaded pork cutlet) to vegetarian bibimbap and more! The park offers splendid scenery harmoniously harboring beautiful ponds, streams, and grassy fields. [Place] Hangang Art Park
[Category] Culture > Parks
[Summary] A beautiful interactive park and resting area for visitors to enjoy up to 37 different public art works that put an artistic spin on the Hangang River from a cultural arts perspective. Stop on by for some personal healing amid the cold, bustling life of the city in this beautifully imaginative park dedicated to the arts filled with inspiration, wonder, and enjoyment.
[Description] Breaking away from the common idea that the Hangang River serves as simply a place of leisure and picnicking, the Hangang Art Park aims to present the river in a much different light. Guided by the philosophy, "Hangang, art in the flow," the park seeks to create a Hangang River that gently flows along its course at the hands of artistry. In other words, the goal is to advocate the rebirth of the Hangang River park area as a place of thoughtful communication and exchange, in line with the concept of a more stimulating and impactful form of leisure that naturally melds with the "stop" and "flow" of the river body itself. The artwork found at the park was selected through a series of art competitions that featured both professional artists and artists among the public. An artwork selection committee, comprised of specialists from a variety of fields, then worked faithfully to develop and promote the chosen artwork, which the committee had selected on the basis of not only the representation of geographical characteristics, but also substance and diversity. It was through this process of selection that the artwork currently on display was chosen, all of which belong to one of the four specified themes of the park: "Lively," "Relaxed," "Inspiring," and "Secretive."

document_text:
[Place] National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea
[Category] Festivals/Events/Performances > Festivals
[Summary] The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (Seoul) is the new heart of Korean culture in the city as well as a visitor-oriented museum with various convenience facilities. Visitors can enjoy both contemporary and modern art at the museum. The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (Seoul), also known as an "open museum in the city," is the very place where visitors can experience the joys of culture and the arts in Seoul.
[Description] The National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (Seoul) is a complex arts and cultural center with various facilities such as the Digital Information Room, Multi-project Hall, theater, and educational space. Visitors can encounter culture and arts of various genres through various exhibitions, films, performances, and educational experiences where they can catch a glimpse of modern art. The Seoul branch, surrounded by a yard, sits in the old Defense Security Command building and Jongchinbu Government Office. Visitors can also appreciate a painting of Inwangsan Mountain through the "Inwang Jesaekdo," by Jeong Seon (Kyomjae). The Seoul branch, which sits across from Korea's most central area of Gyeongbokgung Palace, aims to be an open museum that prioritizes communication with locals and foreign visitors. The museum is an "open museum in the city" where anyone can enjoy modern and contemporary art.

[Summary] Come explore the last section of the Gyeongchun Line Forest Park where the once Hwarangdae Station once stood!
[Description] Located at the last section of the Gyeongchun Line Forest Park, the last way station of Seoul and former stop, Hwarangdae Station, has now been turned into a park! The park is lined with old trains that were once in operation at one point in time, and is also home to a light garden, railroad and time museum, train cafe, and much more! The light garden is set up across a 400 m section of the former Hwarangdae Station area, while offering 10 unique night courses with differently-themed sculptures that includes a secret flower garden, light tunnel, music garden, light garden, sky light garden, tree of life, fantasy train station, Milky Way garden, forest storyland, and firefly garden.

[Category] Culture > Cultural Districts
[Summary] A picturesque hanok village located at the foot of Bukhansan Mountain in Jingwan-dong
[Description] Located in Jingwan-dong of Eunpyeong-gu, the Eunpyeong Hanok Village captures a quaint, serene landscape with the Bukhansan Mountain serving as the backdrop for the modern, neatly-built hanoks. The village is set in greater Seoul in the vicinity of Yeonsinnae and Ilsan. If you take a snapshot from the middle of the road between the tall hanok structures, it'll give you the feeling of standing on the set of some historical film set during the Joseon Dynasty. There are also plenty of sites to see if you walk up from the hanok village along the deck path that will lead you to the Jingwansa Temple, Literature Museum, and more!

[설명] 강감찬 전시관은 1019년 거란과의 전투를 대승으로 이끌었던 고려의 명장 강감찬 장군을 기리기 위해 건립되었다. 강감찬의 본적은 옛 금천현(衿川縣), 현재의 관악구 낙성대에서 태어나 자랐으며 전시실내 ‘별의 탄생’ 존에서 이를 소개한다. ‘별빛의 영웅’ 존에서는 고려역사와 대외정세를 보여 주고 거란과의 전투, 특히 귀주대첩에서 강감찬의 활약상을 조명하고 있다. ‘별이 비춘 세상’ 존에서는 강감찬 관련 설화를 소개하고 있으며, 트릭아트 포토존에서 추억을 남길 수 있다.

[Place] Kang Gam-chan Exhibit Hall
[Category] Festivals/Events/Performances > Festivals
[Summary] Kang Gam-chan Exhibit Hall, where you can meet Great Commander Kang Gam-chan who played an active role in the golden age of Goryeo.
[Description] Kang Gam-chan Exhibit Hall was established to commemorate Great Commander Kang Gam-chan of Goryeo who led the great victory in the battle with the Khitan in 1019. Kang Gam-chan was born and grew up in Geumcheon-hyeon (currently Nakseongdae, Gwanak-gu), which is introduced in the "Birth of a Star" zone in the exhibition hall. In the "Shining Star Hero" zone, visitors can learn about the history of Goryeo and the international circumstances of the times. In particular, the battle with Khitan and the performance of Commander Kang are highlighted in the zone. In the "Starlit World" zone, a tale related to Kang Gam-chan is introduced and visitors can take a memorable photo in the "Trick Art" photo zone.

[Summary] Hongneung Forest used to be the grounds of the tombs of King Gojong (the 26th king of Joseon) and Empress Myeongseong. It is a historical place as the first-generation arboretum in Korea.
[Description] The nation’s first arboretum was created in Hongneung Forest in 1922. document_title: Autumn Trail, Namsan Southern Walking Path
document_text:
[Place] Autumn Trail, Namsan Southern Walking Path
[Category] Nature > Natural Sites(Mountains)
[Summary] A path spanning 1.3 km that starts from the Namsan National Theater intersection and ends near the Namsan 3-ho Tunnel!
[Description] The lengthy trail taking a wide sweep around Namsan Mountain while being known for its particularly scenic landscape during the autumn season, earned the name, "Autumn Trail" some years ago. There are a total of four distinct courses, including Namsan Southern Walking Path, Namsan Northern Walking Path, Sowol-ro, and Namsan Outdoor Botanical Garden. Also known as "Itaewon-ro," the Namsan Southern Walking Path is filled to the brim with striking Oriental Plane trees makng for an amazing vista of autumn foliage! It spans a total of 1.3 km from Namsan National Theater Intersection to the Namsan 3-ho Tunnel and is at the peak of fall viewing from late October to early November.
[Tags] Autumn, AutumnOuting, NamsanTrail, FallTrail, WalkingPath, FoliageTrail, NamsanSouthernWalkingPath, AutumnTrail

[Place] Salgoji-gil
[Category] Culture > Parks
[Summary] A scenic path perfect for taking some beautiful autumn ginkgo trees and silver grass fields.
[Description] Beginning at Gwangnaru-gil (284-108, Seongsu-dong 2-ga, Seongdong-gu) while sometimes referred to as the "Ginkgo Tree Trail," Salgoji-gil is a beautiful path for taking that autumn stroll. The trail runs until Ttukseom-gil (72-129, Seongsu-dong 1-ga, Seongdong-gu) and earned its name from the Salgoji Bridge, which was built during the Joseon Dynasty and designated as National Treasure no. 1738 several decades later. The trail attracts crowds of eager walkers looking to enjoy a nice stroll as the trail itself connects where the Cheonggyecheon Stream meets the Hangang River. Along the trail, you can see Hanyang University, Hanyang Women's University, Seoul Metropolitan Facilities Management Corporation, and other sights of the city.

[Description] A ceramics studio located in Samcheong-dong's Bukchon Hanok Village, ONDO Studio provides a space for the creation of ceramics by hand that capture a warm hue and slim contour. The studio also benefits from the warm ambiance of being located within an actual hanok and offers new ceramics workshops every month! [Place] Seokpajeong
[Category] History > Historical Sites > Others Historical Sites
[Summary] A garden that was tended to by the ruling class during the Joseon Dynasty
[Description] The name of this historical complex, "Seokpachon," translates into English as "surrounded by water, soaring above the clouds" and was given in honor of the great Heungseon Daewongun, the regent of the Joseon Kingdom. The Seokpachon complex is more than 600 years old, but it has been able to maintain its original appearance through careful preservation. This place is remarkable for its extraordinary beauty and it displays a combination of traditional Korean and Chinese architecture. This historic garden is currently under the authority of the Seoul Museum, which celebrates traditional and contemporary Korean art throughout the world.

[Place] Ansan Mountain
[Category] Nature > Natural Sites(Mountains)
[Summary] Ansan Mountain is 295.5 meters high and it is located in the Seodaemun-gu district of Seoul.
[Description] Located in the Seodaemun-gu district of Seoul, Ansan Mountain is 295.5 meters high and is popular for its easy hiking trails and beautiful scenery. While there are multiple paths to choose from, the trail on the eastern side of the mountain is the most well-known as it passes by Independence Park, the location of the historic Seodaemun Prison. Many of the paths up the mountain are made up of a boardwalk, so anyone of any age can make this trek without worrying about slipping or tripping. At the top of Ansan is an observation deck with a jaw-dropping view of Seoul and the surrounding area. Additionally, Bongwonsa Temple, which is the head temple of the Taego Order of Korean Buddhism, is located at the bottom of the southeastern hillside of the mountain.

[Description] Sewoon Cheonggye Shopping Mall, built as a residential and commercial building in the 1960s, appeared as "Geumga Plaza" in the drama Vincenzo and has become a hot place to visit ever since. Visit Sewoon Cheonggye Shopping Mall and the popular cafes in the Euljiro district as you recall scenes from your favorite TV series.

[Place] National Aviation Museum of Korea
[Category] Culture > Cultural Facilities > Museums
[Summary] The National Aviation Museum of Korea is the first museum of its kind in Korea and is located on the site of Gimpo Airport in Gangseo-gu, Seoul. The museum consists of various exhibitions and interactive displays where visitors can witness the past, present, and future of aviation come together.
[Description] The National Aviation Museum of Korea, located at Gimpo Airport, is the first national museum in the aviation field established by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport to organize Korea's aviation history and promote collective understanding of the aviation industry. The National Aviation Museum of Korea consists of the Aviation History Hall, where visitors can learn about the history of Korean aviation, the Aviation Industry Hall, where visitors can get a glimpse of the current state of the aviation industry, and the Aviation Future Hall, where visitors can see various aviation technologies, airplanes and models for the future. Additionally, there is a unique experience space for those who have always dreamed of flying. Here, visitors can experience aviation through five different spaces including the Black Eagle boarding experience, an in-flight training experience, a pilot control experience, the air sports experience, and the children's airport experience.

[Summary] The highest mountain in Jungnang-gu and the highest peak in Achasan Mountain.
[Description] Yongmasan Mountain is the highest mountain in Jungnang-gu and the highest peak of Achasan Mountain. Yongmasan Mountain, famous for its wonderful views, has a hiking course that's good for beginners. Before beginning your hike, visit Yongma Waterfall Park to view the man-made waterfalls and stop by Yongmasanjeong Pavilion to take a break and view the scenery. The course to Yongmabong Peak consists of many stairs. From the Yongmasan Observatory, you can easily see the views of Seoul in one glance. Thanks to the beautiful sunset and night view from Yongmasan Mountain it is a very popular place for night hiking.

[Place] Chundangji Pond
[Category] Culture > Parks
[Summary] On the rear garden grounds of Changgyeonggung Palace sits Chundangji Pond
[Description] On the rear garden grounds of Changgyeonggung Palace sits Chundangji Pond. It is known for its beautiful nature and fall foliage. Chundangji consists of two parts. The smaller upper half is the original location of the pond, while the lower half was initially used as a naenongpo , a place for the royal court to experiment with planting crops such as rice. However, during the Japanese occupation in 1909, the naenongpo was converted into a pond. In 1986, it was renovated into a traditional Korean style. Visitors can also see the seven-story pagoda, made in 1470, sitting on the shore of the pond.
